remediations.problem: small-file amplification: micro-batch commits amplify into small data files and consumer scan overhead

actions.description: Adjust the streaming trigger interval (larger micro-batches, or Trigger.AvailableNow for periodic catch-up)
actions.expected_effect: fewer commits, larger writes per commit

actions.description: Review output partitioning so each batch writes a bounded set of files
actions.rationale: unpartitioned fan-out multiplies files per commit
actions.expected_effect: files per commit near target size

actions.description: Compact existing small data files (rewrite_data_files / OPTIMIZE)
actions.rationale: backlog of small files must be merged separately
actions.expected_effect: file count drops toward steady state
actions.validation: file count and avg size meet targets

actions.description: Re-run consumer metrics (Athena scan/planning times, file counts)
actions.rationale: close the loop - confirm the chain is broken

actions.rationale: the fix needs the actual hot key

actions.description: Salt the skewed keys or split the join into skewed/non-skewed parts
actions.rationale: distributes the hot key across tasks
